name: Qwen3.8 27B

release_date.note: Raschka gallery date; HF repo created 2026-08-05

params.note: derived from config, language stack only, embeddings counted as active; adding the MTP layer (424,699,392) and the vision tower (460,730,096) gives exactly the HF safetensors count; README: 27B

tokenizer.note: tokenizer.json: ByteLevel, 248,044 base tokens; vocab_size 248,320 is padded (README)

mixers.note: 16 QK heads, 48 V heads, head dim 128; depthwise conv kernel 4
gated attention: 24 Q / 4 KV heads of 256, output gate, QK-norm, RoPE on 64 dims

position.nope_layers: the 48 Gated DeltaNet layers carry no position encoding

steps.label: conv kernel 4 on q, k, v; gated RMSNorm on output
24 Q / 4 KV heads of 256, QK-norm, partial interleaved M-RoPE
gate from q_proj on the attention output

specials.name: gated_deltanet
specials.what: linear-recurrent mixer with gated delta rule; 3 of every 4 layers

specials.name: gated_attention
specials.what: full-attention output multiplied by a gate computed from the input

specials.name: short_conv
specials.what: depthwise convolution of kernel 4 on q, k, v inside Gated DeltaNet

specials.name: mrope
specials.what: interleaved multimodal RoPE, sections 11/11/10 (time, height, width) over the 64 rotated dims

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: one multi-token prediction layer (mtp.* weights), trained with multiple steps

omitted_towers.what: ViT, 27 layers, width 1152, patch 16, temporal patch 2 (video), 2x2 spatial merge

code.note: decoder layer: input_layernorm, linear_attn or self_attn, add, post_attention_layernorm, mlp, add; RMSNorm * (1 + weight)

idx.note: linear_attn.* on the DeltaNet layers, self_attn.q_norm/k_norm on the attention layers, mtp.* present

gal.note: entry 'Qwen3.8 27B': date, 16 gated attention + 48 DeltaNet, 248,320 vocab

count.note: same per-layer formulas as Qwen3-Next (which match its safetensors count exactly); vision tower = 27 ViT blocks + patch and position embeddings + merger

unknowns.attention.other: gate function of gated attention: config says swish, reference code uses sigmoid

notes: README: context 262,144 natively, extensible to about 1M tokens with YaRN factor 4; config allows 262,144.
Config sets output_gate_type 'swish'; the transformers qwen3_5 code read for this record applies a sigmoid gate and does not read that key. The record names the gate without fixing its function.
Dense: a plain SwiGLU FFN follows every mixer; README layout 16 x (3 x (Gated DeltaNet -> FFN) -> 1 x (Gated Attention -> FFN)).

gated_deltanet.note: 16 query/key heads, 48 value heads; conv kernel 4
